note: Static-analysis hypotheses unless a finding says otherwise; no live Foundry measurement exists.

findings.title: 36 ungated createItem/updateItem write listeners run on every client and on every item update
findings.observed: Each of the 18 live families registers Hooks.on(createItem) and Hooks.on(updateItem) with the signature (item, options) and no userId/owner check; Foundry fires these on every connected client. For a matching feat each client calls ActorEngine.updateEmbeddedDocuments with a full metadata patch, without diffing against current values; any update to the feat (e.g. toggling) re-issues the patch. FeatEffectApplier shows the project's correct pattern (game.user.id !== userId return).
findings.intendedOwnership: One write per lifecycle event on the originating client; ideally metadata is derived at build time from canonical data (see F-FEA-003).
findings.proposedSolution: Replace the 18 family listeners with one feat-normalization dispatcher (single createItem/updateItem pair) gated on game.user.id === userId, that looks up the family by canonical id/name in a table and skips when the computed patch equals current values.
findings.alternatives: Minimal: add the userId gate and a no-op diff to each family; or move metadata into the generated pack so no runtime normalization is needed.
findings.regressionTests: Offline: shim test that one createItem fires exactly one ActorEngine write with two simulated users; unchanged patch triggers no write.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Two clients (GM + owning player) add Force Boon; confirm one update and no permission errors in the non-owner console.
findings.risk: Normalization order assumptions in register-feat-runtime.js:10-13 must be preserved by the dispatcher

findings.title: getSuggestions (read path) performs sequential actor flag writes
findings.observed: On a cache miss in levelup/chargen/mentor/decision-step contexts, _recordSuggestionsShown loops over up to 8 suggestions and each SelectionRecorder.recordSuggestionShown awaits a separate actor.setFlag (each a server round-trip plus updateActor broadcast and sheet re-render). It also runs during chargen/level-up before finalization, contrary to OSI 'temporary choices live in session/draft state'.
findings.intendedOwnership: Evaluation is pure (ENGINE-ARCH §10); analytics persisted once, outside the read path.
findings.proposedSolution: Hypothesis to confirm with instrumentation (count updateActor per getSuggestions). Then batch into one write after the step closes, or record only on explicit selection.
findings.alternatives: Keep history in client memory per session.
findings.regressionTests: Unit test with a mock actor counting setFlag calls per getSuggestions (expect 0 or 1).
findings.foundryAcceptance: Count re-renders while paging a feat step.

findings.title: Passive ability re-registration runs 2-3 times per mutation
findings.observed: AbilityExecutionCoordinator.registerActorAbilities runs in every prepareDerivedData, and again in updateActor (every client, every update), createItem and deleteItem hooks. Foundry re-prepares after each of these events, so the hook calls appear redundant. Hypothesis: not measured.
findings.proposedSolution: Instrument with ActorPerfDiagnostics counters; if confirmed, remove the three hook registrations (keep prepare-phase registration).
findings.regressionTests: Counter-based test: one registration per update.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Measure with performanceDiagnostics on a large actor.
findings.risk: Medium: ordering assumptions about passive modifiers before derived.

findings.title: Cleave target-dropped emitted from ungated updateActor watcher and swse.damageApplied
findings.observed: The updateActor HP watcher has no userId gate (fires on every client) and the swse.damageApplied listener treats a missing previousHp as positive; ActorEngine emits swse.damageApplied without previousHp/currentHp. emitTargetDropped posts a Cleave chat card per invocation (288). Duplicate cards per client and per path are likely; not run in Foundry.
findings.intendedOwnership: One emission from the damage authority with before/after HP.
findings.proposedSolution: Drop the updateActor watcher; have ActorEngine include hpBefore/hpAfter in swse.damageApplied and emit only on the originating client; dedupe by event id.
findings.alternatives: Gate the watcher on userId and dedupe per actor/round.
findings.regressionTests: Shim test: one drop -> one swse.cleaveAvailable.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Two clients connected, drop a target to 0 HP; count Cleave cards.

findings.title: Prerequisite integrity evaluation runs on every recalcAll
findings.observed: Every ActorEngine.recalcAll (after each updateActor, owned-item change, flag change) awaits PrerequisiteIntegrityChecker.evaluate(actor), whose result is only logged. Hypothesis: measurable cost on actors with many feats/talents; not measured.
findings.intendedOwnership: Integrity reporting is opt-in or scoped to item-set changes.
findings.proposedSolution: Instrument with ActorPerfDiagnostics; then run only when items changed or when Sentinel is enabled.
findings.regressionTests: Counter test: flag-only update does not run integrity evaluation.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Profile a level-15 character sheet edit.

findings.title: Global render listeners: V1 hook names on V2 apps and post-render DOM repair
findings.observed: Discovery and the responsive observer listen to renderApplication/renderActorSheet/renderItemSheet; Foundry V13 ApplicationV2 fires render<ClassName> hooks for its own inheritance chain (renderActorSheetV2, renderApplicationV2), so these probably never fire for SWSE V2 sheets (suspected; unverified live). Eight live renderApplicationV2 listeners in force/patch modules run DOM repair on every app render of any kind.
findings.intendedOwnership: Sheets bind their own tooltip/observer in _onRender; no post-render global repairs (A-09).
findings.proposedSolution: Instrument: count hook invocations per render in a live world. Replace V1 hook names with renderApplicationV2 or direct calls from SWSEV2ActorSheetBase._onRender; fold repair logic into the owning sheet render (B-CPT compat-patches owns hotfix retirement).
findings.regressionTests: Hook-name contract test listing allowed global render hooks.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Live V13: confirm whether discovery tooltips bind on V2 sheets; measure render time with listeners disabled.

findings.title: Hotfix DOM repair runs on every renderApplicationV2
findings.observed: repairCombatTabWeaponDisplay and scrubHiddenDefensesInRollDialog listen to all ApplicationV2 renders; early-exit cost unmeasured.
findings.proposedSolution: Instrument count/time; scope to sheet class or delete with F-CMB-007.

findings.title: Encumbrance computed twice per actor prepare
findings.observed: mirrorEncumbrance and ModifierEngine._getEncumbranceModifiers each call calculateEncumbrance (iterates items).
findings.proposedSolution: Instrument; if measurable, compute once per prepare and pass the state to ModifierEngine (cache keyed on prepare cycle).

findings.title: 5.2k-SLOC JS seed catalog loaded at init through settings registration
findings.observed: settings.js statically imports location-registry-service.js to register one setting. That module statically imports the full Location Library seed catalog, so every client parses it at startup.
findings.intendedOwnership: Setting registration should not pull content catalogs.
findings.proposedSolution: Hypothesis. Measure module parse time. If material, move the registration function to a small module, or dynamic-import the seeds in the library-import path.
findings.alternatives: Convert seeds to JSON loaded on demand.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Measure world load time before and after.

findings.title: All game sessions in one world-setting array rewritten on every move
findings.observed: Each move rewrites and broadcasts the full sessions array (including game state and logs capped at 100), with no write serialization in the store.
findings.proposedSolution: Hypothesis: measure payload size. Add a write queue (as HolonetStorage does) and prune finished sessions.

findings.title: All records and threads stored as two world-setting arrays rewritten per message
findings.observed: Each save reads the full array, edits it and rewrites the setting. Foundry broadcasts the whole setting value to every client. MessengerMaintenanceService prune/compact exists, which shows growth is a known concern.
findings.proposedSolution: Hypothesis: instrument the setting payload size and write latency in a long campaign. If material, shard by thread or move to JournalEntry documents.

findings.title: _buildIntentCache grows without bound
findings.observed: Keys include the actor revision hash, so entries are never stale, but nothing evicts old revisions (clearBuildIntentCache only called from orphan suggestion-hooks.js). SuggestionService's own cache is LRU-bounded.
findings.intendedOwnership: A-16: derived-only cache with explicit invalidation/bounds.
findings.proposedSolution: Add the same LRU bound as SuggestionService or drop old revisions for an actor on insert. Instrument map size in a long session first.
findings.regressionTests: Unit test: N revisions -> map size bounded.

findings.title: Global hooks invalidate TalentBonusCache on every actor/item change
findings.observed: Registered at module evaluation; invalidation on any updateActor (including UI-only flag writes) on every client. Cheap per call; hypothesis that it defeats the cache for active actors.
findings.intendedOwnership: Cache keyed by derived-generation stamp (R-ACT-04) instead of hook invalidation.
findings.proposedSolution: Key TalentBonusCache by the derived generation/signature and drop the hooks; instrument hit rate first.

findings.title: Conditional-grant listeners schedule reconciliation on item and actor changes
findings.observed: createItem/deleteItem of any owned feat and filtered updateActor changes schedule setTimeout reconcile passes; serialized per actor and guarded. Bulk progression finalization creating many feats could queue repeated passes (hypothesis).
findings.proposedSolution: Instrument pass count per finalize; coalesce per actor per tick if >1.
findings.regressionTests: Count reconcile passes when 10 feats are created in one createEmbeddedDocuments call

findings.title: Store view switches re-render the whole app; Holopad caches live SWSEStore instances
findings.observed: currentView changes call this.render() (full AppV2 render). StoreSurfaceService keeps one app instance per actor as its view-model source (has invalidate()). Hypothesis only.
findings.intendedOwnership: OSI performance: UI-only state without full rerender.
findings.proposedSolution: Instrument render count/time per view switch; if significant, extract a StoreSessionModel (cart, filters, view) used by both window and Holopad, render partials.
findings.simplificationBenefit: Holopad stops instantiating a window class as a model.

findings.title: Explicit full render after actor mutations (double render hypothesis)
findings.observed: 11 handlers call this.render(false|true) right after an ActorEngine write that already re-renders the sheet via updateActor.
findings.proposedSolution: Instrument render counts per click; replace with mutateAndRepaint or drop the explicit render.
findings.regressionTests: Render-count test with a stub actor.
findings.simplificationBenefit: Halves renders on those actions if confirmed.

findings.title: Probe false positives and legitimate caches
findings.observed: P-A02/A-04 hits in progression-shell, force-power-step and the enforcer guard are Map/Set.delete. talent-step caches are reset on every onStepEnter and keyed by Block/Deflect mode (invalidation present; probe flag "no invalidate" is a false positive).
findings.proposedSolution: Refine probes to ignore Map/Set .delete and constructor resets.
